definitions.gloss: now on sale; currently available for purchase
definitions.explanation: Indicates that a product, ticket, or item is currently being sold. Very commonly seen on signs, advertisements, and product packaging.

examples.japanese: ⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧{発売中|はつばいちゅう}。
⟦{新刊|しんかん}→新刊：16466_shinkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好評|こうひょう}→好評：16720_kouhyou⟧{発売中|はつばいちゅう}です。
examples.english: The new book is on sale and well received.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧フレーバー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アイス→アイス：06770_aisu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{発売中|はつばいちゅう}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{見|み}かけたら→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧ぜひ⟦{試|ため}して→試す：02130_tamesu⟧みて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: A summer-limited ice cream flavor is currently on sale at convenience stores nationwide, so if you see it, definitely give it a try.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧ (sale, release) + ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (during, in progress). One of many 〜⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ compounds indicating an ongoing state. Extremely common in advertising, store signage, and product announcements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{好評|こうひょう}→好評：16720_kouhyou⟧{発売中|はつばいちゅう}: on sale to great acclaim
- ⟦{絶賛|ぜっさん}→絶賛：13840_zessan⟧{発売中|はつばいちゅう}: now on sale (emphatic marketing phrase)
- ⟦{数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}→数量限定：09822_suuryougentei⟧{発売中|はつばいちゅう}: on sale in limited quantities
- ⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{発売中|はつばいちゅう}: on sale nationwide

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {販売中|はんばいちゅう}: currently selling — very similar, slightly more formal
- ⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧: release, sale — the action of putting something on sale
- ⟦{売|う}り{出|だ}し→売り出す：06039_uridasu⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: on sale, special sale in progress — often implies a promotional sale
